const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Generate and validate an open-loop trajectory for the frozen MolmoSpaces episode."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_molmospaces import Session
+
+
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+OUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
+
+
+def make_rows(session):
+    index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(session.layout)}
+    hold = np.asarray(session.hold_row(), dtype=np.float64)
+    rows = []
+
+    # Waypoints pass through the doorway at (8.63, 7.0), then approach the
+    # nearer tablelamp from the east side of its room.
+    route = [
+        ((8.40, 9.40), 8),
+        ((8.63, 7.50), 9),
+        ((8.63, 6.20), 8),
+        ((7.20, 6.00), 8),
+        ((5.70, 6.00), 9),
+        ((4.20, 5.80), 9),
+        ((3.00, 5.80), 8),
+        ((2.00, 5.65), 8),
+    ]
+    for (x, y), count in route:
+        row = hold.copy()
+        row[index["base_x"]] = x
+        row[index["base_y"]] = y
+        rows.extend([row.copy() for _ in range(count)])
+
+    # Turn the head camera toward the lamp and allow the base yaw to settle.
+    row = hold.copy()
+    row[index["base_x"]] = 2.00
+    row[index["base_y"]] = 5.65
+    row[index["base_theta"]] = 3.00
+    rows.extend([row.copy() for _ in range(10)])
+    return np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float64)
+
+
+def main():
+    session = Session(INSTANCE)
+    rows = make_rows(session)
+    Path(OUT).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    session.save_trajectory(rows, OUT)
+    print(f"saved {len(rows)} rows to {OUT}")
+
+    for i, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
+        if not session.step(row):
+            break
+        if session.status()["success"]:
+            # The benchmark judges the terminal state, so trim after first success.
+            rows = rows[:i]
+            session.save_trajectory(rows, OUT)
+            print(f"success at step {i}; saved terminal trajectory")
+            return
+    print("terminal status:", session.status())
+    print("base:", session.proprio()["joint_pos"][:3])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
